definition_zh: 程序；步骤；手续；医疗操作；议事规程；子程序；工序
definition_en: a fixed set of steps that must be followed to carry out a task, a formal process or a medical treatment
core_image: 手术室外的走廊上，一张写满步骤的卡片贴在墙上，医生拿笔逐项打勾
scene: 手术开始前，主刀医生和护士对着墙上的步骤卡逐项核对了一遍。The team followed the written procedure step by step before the operation began.
sceneCN: 句中的说法指「为完成某事而必须依次执行的一套步骤」（第 1 个义项：固定顺序的操作步骤）；句意为手术开始前，团队按书面步骤逐项执行。图中可辨识物件：步骤卡、打勾用的笔、手术室门、走廊指示灯；对应第 1 个义项。

derivatives.zh: 进行中的事项；诉讼程序

senses.title: A fixed series of steps
senses.definition: an ordered set of actions that must be followed to complete a task
senses.definitionCN: 为完成某项任务而必须依次执行的一组动作
senses.example: The lab has a written procedure for handling every sample.
senses.exampleCN: 实验室对每一个样本的处理都有书面步骤。
senses.why: The word came from a verb meaning to go forward, so a procedure is a path laid out to be walked in order.
senses.whyCN: 这个词出自意为「向前走」的动词，因此程序就是一条铺好、须按顺序走完的路线。

senses.title: The official way of handling a matter
senses.definition: the recognized sequence by which an official body accepts, hears or decides something
senses.definitionCN: 官方机构受理、审议或决定某事所认可的次序
senses.example: The complaint went through the standard procedure for appeals.
senses.exampleCN: 这项投诉走了标准的上诉手续。
senses.why: Anything a body must do in a set order becomes a procedure, because the order is what makes the decision valid.
senses.whyCN: 机构必须按固定次序完成的事都叫程序，因为正是这个次序使决定有效。

senses.title: A medical treatment that acts on the body
senses.definition: a treatment in which a doctor performs a defined action on or inside the body
senses.definitionCN: 医生在体表或体内施行的一套明确操作
senses.example: The procedure took forty minutes and needed no overnight stay.
senses.exampleCN: 这台操作用了四十分钟，不需要留院过夜。
senses.why: Medicine borrowed the word for any defined course of action on a patient, and the sense narrowed to interventions.
senses.whyCN: 医学借这个词指对病人的一套明确处置，后来收窄为各种介入操作。

senses.title: The accepted order of business in a meeting
senses.definition: the rules that govern how a meeting or assembly conducts its business
senses.definitionCN: 会议或议会处理事务时遵循的规则
senses.example: The chair reminded the committee of its own procedure.
senses.exampleCN: 主席提醒委员会注意自己定的议事规程。
senses.why: A meeting is valid only if it moves through the agreed steps, so the rules of order took this name.
senses.whyCN: 会议只有按商定的步骤推进才有效，因此议事规则也用了这个名称。

senses.title: A named block of code in a program
senses.definition: a section of a program that performs one task and returns control to the point that called it
senses.definitionCN: 程序中完成单项任务并把控制权交回调用处的一段代码
senses.example: The program calls the same procedure every time it reads a record.
senses.exampleCN: 程序每读一条记录就调用同一个子程序。
senses.why: Computing reused the word for a routine because a routine is a small ordered path through the machine's work.
senses.whyCN: 计算机把这个词用于例行程序，因为一段例程就是机器工作中一条小型有序路径。

senses.title: The usual way a job is done in a place
senses.definition: the established way of doing a job in a particular workplace, whether or not it is written down
senses.definitionCN: 某一工作场所既定的做事方式，无论是否写成文字
senses.example: Checking the seals twice is procedure on this rig, not a personal habit.
senses.exampleCN: 在这座钻井平台上，密封件查两遍是规程，不是个人习惯。
senses.why: An unwritten habit becomes procedure once a crew treats it as the required order, so the word covers custom as well as rule.
senses.whyCN: 一旦班组把它当作必须遵循的次序，未成文的习惯也成了程序，因此这个词兼指惯例与规章。

senses.title: The steps by which a case moves through court
senses.definition: the rules that fix what a party must file, when and in what form during litigation
senses.definitionCN: 规定当事人在诉讼中须提交什么、何时提交、以何种形式提交的规则
senses.example: Civil procedure decides what a plaintiff must file and when.
senses.exampleCN: 民事诉讼程序决定原告必须提交什么、何时提交。
senses.why: Legal systems separate substance from steps, and the steps are called procedure because they carry a case forward in order.
senses.whyCN: 法律体系把实体与步骤分开，而这些步骤被称为程序，因为它们按次序把一个案子往前推进。

senses.title: One stage in an industrial process
senses.titleCN: 工序；工艺流程中的一环
senses.definition: a single defined operation within a manufacturing or chemical sequence
senses.definitionCN: 制造或化工流程中一道界限明确的加工步骤
senses.example: Each procedure in the line has its own temperature range.
senses.exampleCN: 流水线上每一道工序都有自己的温度区间。
senses.why: A factory breaks a long making into ordered steps, and each step inherits the name of the whole path.
senses.whyCN: 工厂把漫长的制造拆成有序步骤，每一道步骤都继承了整条路径的名称。

intro.en: Procedure came through French from Latin procedere 'to go forward', built on pro- 'forward' and cedere 'to go, to yield'. The pre-Latin root of cedere is a reconstruction. Dates are approximate.
intro.cn: 这个词经法语来自拉丁语「向前走」的动词，由意为「向前」的前缀与意为「走、让」的动词构成。后者更早的词根属重构形式。年代均为约数。

items.en: Cedere meant 'to go, to withdraw, to yield'. Its deeper origin is not attested; the root usually proposed for it is a reconstruction, so source uncertain at that depth.
items.cn: cedere 意为「走、退、让」。其更深来源没有书证；通常为它提出的词根属重构形式，故更深一层来源不确定。

items.en: Pro- 'forward' plus cedere produced procedere 'to go forward, to advance, to continue'.
items.cn: pro-「向前」加 cedere 构成 procedere，意为「向前走、推进、继续」。

items.en: Late and Medieval Latin formed procedura for the manner of proceeding in a matter, especially in law.
items.cn: 晚期与中世纪拉丁语构成 procedura，指处理某事的进行方式，尤用于法律。

items.en: French procédure brought the noun into English in the fourteenth century, first as the conduct of a legal action.
items.cn: 法语 procédure 在十四世纪把这个名词带入英语，最初指法律诉讼的进行方式。

items.en: From the seventeenth century the word covered meeting rules, from the nineteenth medical interventions, and from the twentieth a block of code in computing.
items.cn: 自十七世纪起，这个词涵盖议事规则；十九世纪起涵盖医疗介入；二十世纪起涵盖计算机中的代码段。

note.en: Group one holds words built on the same Latin verb of going, plus one word of Greek origin that looks similar; group two holds words for ways of doing things.
note.cn: 第一组是同出拉丁「走」动词的词，外加一个形似而来源不同的希腊词；第二组是表示做事方式的近义词。

entries.definition: A continuous course of change rather than an ordered checklist; the same Latin verb, a different noun suffix.
entries.definitionCN: 指连续变化的过程，而非有序清单；同一拉丁动词，名词后缀不同。

entries.definition: The carrying on of an action, or its record in court; it names the activity, not the rules for it.
entries.definitionCN: 指行动的进行，或其在法庭上的记录；它指活动本身，而不是活动的规则。

entries.definition: Pra- 'before' plus cedere: something that went before and now guides later decisions, not a set of steps.
entries.definitionCN: pra-「在前」加 cedere：先前发生、如今指导后续决定的事例，不是一套步骤。

entries.definition: From Greek protokollon, the first sheet glued to a roll; it became a diplomatic or technical code, not a Latin path.
entries.definitionCN: 出自希腊语「贴在卷首的第一张纸」，后来指外交或技术约定，与拉丁的「路径」无关。

entries.definition: A systematic way of doing something, often chosen by the doer rather than imposed by an authority.
entries.definitionCN: 系统性的做法，常由执行者自行选择，而非由权威规定。

entries.definition: A regular way of doing something because it is familiar and repeated, with no claim of formal validity.
entries.definitionCN: 因熟悉而重复的惯常做法，并不强调正式效力。

entries.definition: A single action in a sequence; a procedure is the whole sequence of such actions.
entries.definitionCN: 序列中的单个动作；程序则是这些动作的整个序列。

entries.definition: The organized set of parts and rules taken together, wider than one procedure.
entries.definitionCN: 由各部分与规则构成的整体安排，比单个程序更宽。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: real morphemes, real collocations and real relatives, not invented rhymes.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：真实的构词成分、真实搭配与真实同族词，而非编造的顺口溜。

normal.en: 'Forward' plus 'to go': a procedure is a path laid out so that work can be walked through in order.
normal.cn: 「向前」加「走」：程序就是一条铺好的路径，让工作按顺序走完。

normal.en: The same verb yields the verb to continue, the noun for a court record and the word for a continuous process.
normal.cn: 同一动词还给出表示「继续」的动词、表示法庭记录的名词，以及表示连续过程的名词。

normal.en: Fixed phrases mark the settings: standard procedure, safety procedure, legal procedure, surgical procedure.
normal.cn: 固定说法标出场景：标准程序、安全规程、法律程序、外科手术。

normal.en: A hospital, a court and a committee each keep a written path that must be followed in order.
normal.cn: 医院、法院与委员会各自都有一份必须按顺序走完的书面路径。

normal.en: Computing calls a small ordered routine a procedure because it is a short path through the machine's work.
normal.cn: 计算机把一小段有序例程称为子程序，因为它是机器工作中一条短路径。

abstract.en: Picture a corridor with numbered doors, each of which must be opened before the next one.
abstract.cn: 想象一条走廊，每隔一段有一扇编号的门，必须依次打开。

abstract.en: Picture a dance notation that only works if every count is danced in place.
abstract.cn: 想象一份舞谱，只有每一拍都踩准才成立。

abstract.en: Picture a legal file that is valid only because every stamp sits in the right order.
abstract.cn: 想象一份法律卷宗，只因每枚印章次序正确才有效。

examples.en: Changing the procedure required the approval of the whole committee.
examples.cn: 更改程序需要全体委员会批准。

examples.en: The surgeon explained the procedure to the family in plain words.
examples.cn: 外科医生用平实的话向家属解释了这台手术。

examples.en: A missing signature sent the file back to the start of the procedure.
examples.cn: 少了一个签名，文件被退回程序的起点。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「pro（向前）+ ced（走）+ ure（名词）」——一路向前走完的路线 → 程序、步骤、手续

root: 拉丁语「向前走」的动词由意为「向前」的前缀与意为「走、让」的动词构成，加名词后缀再构成「进行方式」；该动词更早的词根属重构形式。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses follow one path: a set of steps is laid down, then adopted by an office, applied to a body, imposed on a meeting, coded into a machine, hardened into local custom, stretched into litigation and finally shortened to one stage on a factory line.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项沿一条路径展开：先铺下一套步骤，再被机构采用、施于身体、用于会议、写进机器，固化为本地惯例，延伸为诉讼，最后缩短为工厂流水线上的一环。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a numbered card on the wall of a hospital corridor, each line ticked in order before anyone may proceed.
core.cn: 核心意象：医院走廊墙上一张编号卡片，每一行都按顺序打勾后才允许继续。

branches.en: LAID PATH AND LOCAL HABIT: a written sequence and an unwritten one are the same order once a crew treats it as required.
branches.cn: 铺好的路径与本地习惯：书面次序与未成文次序，一旦被班组视为必须，便是同一种次序。

branches.en: FORMAL VALIDITY: what an office accepts and what a court requires are both orders that make a result valid.
branches.cn: 正式效力：机构受理与法院要求，都是使结果有效的次序。

branches.en: ONE OPERATION: a treatment on a body and a stage on a line are single steps cut out of a longer path.
branches.cn: 单次操作：施于身体的一台操作与流水线上的一道工序，都是从更长路径中截出的单步。

branches.en: RULES OF ORDER: a meeting valid only if it moves through the agreed steps.
branches.cn: 议事规则：会议只有按商定步骤推进才有效。

branches.en: CODED PATH: computing writes the same ordered path into a block of instructions.
branches.cn: 编码路径：计算机把同一条有序路径写成一段指令。

intro.en: Procedure is a Latin noun of path and motion: a prefix meaning forward, a verb meaning to go, and a noun suffix marking the result.
intro.cn: 这是一个表示路径与运动的拉丁名词：一个意为「向前」的前缀、一个意为「走」的动词，以及标记结果的名词后缀。

latinIntro.en: Latin cedere gives proceed, process, precede and succeed; pro- adds forward motion; the noun suffix marks a way of doing.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语「走」动词衍生出继续、过程、先于与接着等词；「向前」前缀加进向前的运动；名词后缀标记一种做法。

items.structure: cedere, cessi, cessum (Latin verb, third conjugation)
items.example: The root carries movement along a line.
items.exampleCN: 这个词根承载沿一条线移动的意思。

items.example: The prefix fixes the direction of the movement.
items.exampleCN: 这个前缀确定运动的方向。

items.example: The verb is the whole path in one word.
items.exampleCN: 这个动词用一个词表达了整条路径。

items.example: The noun turned the path into a thing that can be written down.
items.exampleCN: 这个名词把路径变成可以写下来的东西。

items.example: The English noun still means a path to be walked.
items.exampleCN: 这个英语名词仍指一条要走完的路径。

items.meaning: result or instrument of an action
items.example: The suffix marks the outcome of the verb.
items.exampleCN: 这个后缀标记动词的结果。

items.meaning: relating to steps or formal rules
items.meaningCN: 与步骤或正式规则有关的
items.example: A procedural objection concerns how a decision was made.
items.exampleCN: 程序性异议针对决定是怎么样作出的。

items.example: The train proceeded once the signal changed.
items.exampleCN: 信号一变，列车继续前行。

items.example: The same verb, seen as a flowing course rather than a checklist.
items.exampleCN: 同一个动词，被看作流动的过程而非清单。

latinEntries.meaning: to go, to withdraw, to yield

definition_zh: 继续进行；前进；着手；推进；（法律）起诉；发出（古义）
definition_en: to continue or move forward, especially after a pause or as the next step
core_image: 一条路在岔口干等，绿灯亮起后脚步重新向前
scene: 演示暂停后，主持人拿起翻页笔。The host said we may proceed to the next slide, and the screen changed as soon as the button was pressed.
sceneCN: 这里 proceed 是「继续进行、进入下一步」（第 1 个义项：停顿之后接着往下走）；句意：主持人说我们可以继续看下一张幻灯片，按钮一按屏幕就换了画面。图中可辨识物件：投影屏、翻页笔、讲台、水杯、听众；对应第 1 个义项。

pos.zh: 继续进行；前进；着手；推进；（法律）起诉

senses.title: Continue after a pause
senses.definition: to continue doing something after stopping or waiting
senses.definitionCN: 停止或等待之后继续做某事
senses.example: After a short break, we proceeded with the meeting.
senses.exampleCN: 短暂休息后，我们继续开会。
senses.why: Latin procedere means 'go forward': pro- 'forward' plus cedere 'go'. The word assumes something has stopped and now resumes its motion.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语 procedere 意为“向前走”：pro-“向前”加 cedere“走”。这个词假定某物曾停下，现在重新开始运动。

senses.title: Move forward physically
senses.definition: to move onward in space
senses.definitionCN: 在空间中向前移动
senses.example: The procession proceeded slowly down the street.
senses.exampleCN: 队伍沿街缓慢行进。
senses.why: This is the literal core: feet or wheels moving along a path. Everything abstract in English is borrowed from this simple forward motion.
senses.whyCN: 这是字面的核心：脚或轮子沿路移动。英语里一切抽象义都从这个简单的向前运动借来。

senses.title: Begin or undertake an action
senses.definition: to start doing something as the next step
senses.definitionCN: 作为下一步开始做某事
senses.example: We will proceed to build the prototype.
senses.exampleCN: 我们将着手制作原型。
senses.why: Starting and continuing are close: the next step is both the end of waiting and the beginning of action. The infinitive after proceed marks what is undertaken.
senses.whyCN: 开始与继续很近：下一步既是等待的结束，也是行动的开始。proceed 后接不定式，标记着手的内容。

senses.title: Carry out a plan or process
senses.definition: to carry on with a plan, process, or procedure
senses.definitionCN: 继续推进计划、过程或程序
senses.example: The committee proceeded according to the rules.
senses.exampleCN: 委员会按规则推进。
senses.why: Institutions need a script: proceed means to follow the prescribed steps. The word becomes procedural, which is why procedure is its close relative.
senses.whyCN: 机构需要脚本：proceed 意为按既定步骤走。这个词变得程序化，所以 procedure 是它的近亲。

senses.title: Make progress
senses.definition: to advance toward a goal
senses.definitionCN: 朝目标推进
senses.example: The project is proceeding well.
senses.exampleCN: 项目进展顺利。
senses.why: Forward motion becomes achievement: if the path advances, the work advances. English uses the same metaphor for time, work, and journeys.
senses.whyCN: 向前运动变成成就：路推进，工作就推进。英语用同一个隐喻说时间、工作与旅程。

senses.title: Go on to the next item
senses.definition: in formal speech, to move to the next topic or stage
senses.definitionCN: 正式讲话中，进入下一个话题或阶段
senses.example: Let us proceed to the second question.
senses.exampleCN: 让我们进入第二个问题。
senses.why: Meetings rank items in order. Proceed is the verbal signal that one item is closed and the next opened, a procedural gate rather than a physical one.
senses.whyCN: 会议把议题排序。proceed 是“上一项已关、下一项已开”的口头信号，是程序的关口而非物理关口。

senses.title: Take legal action against
senses.definition: to start or continue a legal action against someone
senses.definitionCN: 对某人开始或继续法律诉讼
senses.example: The company proceeded against the supplier.
senses.exampleCN: 公司对供应商提起诉讼。
senses.why: Law is a path with formal steps: filing, hearing, judgment. To proceed against someone is to set that machinery in motion.
senses.whyCN: 法律是一条有正式步骤的路：提交、听证、判决。proceed against 某人，就是启动这套机器。

senses.title: Come forth or issue from (archaic)
senses.definition: in older usage, to originate or come out from a source
senses.definitionCN: 旧用法：从某个源头产生或出来
senses.example: Light proceeds from the sun.
senses.exampleCN: 光来自太阳。
senses.why: The Latin verb could mean 'come out of'. English kept this for a time: what proceeds from a source moves out of it. Modern usage prefers arise or issue.
senses.whyCN: 这个拉丁动词可指“从……出来”。英语保留过一阵：proceed from 某源，就是从它里面出来。现代多用 arise 或 issue。

senses.title: (Of an event) go forward
senses.definition: of an event or plan, to take place as arranged
senses.definitionCN: 事件或计划按安排进行
senses.example: The wedding will proceed despite the rain.
senses.exampleCN: 尽管下雨，婚礼仍将举行。
senses.why: An event is treated as an object on a path: it can be stopped, delayed, or allowed to proceed. The word grants permission to the future.
senses.whyCN: 事件被当作路上的物件：它可以被停下、推迟，或被允许 proceed。这个词是在给未来发放许可。

intro.en: Proceed is a pure motion word: pro- 'forward' plus cedere 'go'. English borrowed it in the late 14c. and then extended the walk into meetings, projects, and lawsuits.
intro.cn: proceed 是一个纯粹的运动词：pro-“向前”加 cedere“走”。英语在 14 世纪末借入，随后把这场行走扩展到会议、项目与诉讼。

items.en: First recorded with the sense 'go forward, continue one's course'.
items.cn: 最早记录为“向前走、继续行程”。

items.en: From Latin procedere 'go forward, advance, come forth' = pro- 'forward' + cedere 'go, yield'.
items.cn: 来自拉丁语 procedere“向前走、推进、出现”= pro-“向前”+ cedere“走、让”。

items.en: cedere also gives cede, accede, concede, exceed, precede, and succeed. The base is about going or yielding, and the prefix pro- points the going forward.
items.cn: cedere 还生成 cede、accede、concede、exceed、precede、succeed。词基关乎走或让，前缀 pro- 把方向指向前。

items.en: The legal sense 'begin or carry on an action at law' develops, producing proceedings and procedure.
items.cn: 法律义“开始或继续诉讼”发展出来，产生 proceedings 与 procedure。

items.en: Modern English uses proceed for meetings, projects, and formal sequences, always with a sense of a path resumed.
items.cn: 现代英语用 proceed 指会议、项目与正式流程，始终带有“路径重新开始”的意味。

note.en: The first group shares the cedere root; the second is about verbs that also mean continuing or advancing.
note.cn: 第一组共享 cedere 词根，第二组看同样表示“继续”或“推进”的动词。

entries.definition: to come before. It uses prae- 'before' + cedere.
entries.definitionCN: 在……之前。它用 prae-“在前”+ cedere。

entries.definition: to come after; to achieve a goal. It is sub- 'under, next' + cedere.
entries.definitionCN: 随后；成功。它是 sub-“在其后”+ cedere。

entries.definition: a set of steps for doing something. It is proceed plus -ure.
entries.definitionCN: 做某事的步骤。它是 proceed 加 -ure。

entries.definition: to keep doing something without stopping. It stresses duration, not direction.
entries.definitionCN: 不停顿地做下去。它强调持续，而非方向。

entries.definition: to move forward or make progress. It is closer to the physical sense of proceed.
entries.definitionCN: 向前移动或取得进展。它更接近 proceed 的物理义。

entries.definition: to develop toward a better state. It stresses improvement, not sequence.
entries.definitionCN: 朝更好状态发展。它强调改善，而非次序。

normalIntro.en: Real links: Latin cedere 'go', the pro- 'forward' prefix, the proceed/precede/succeed trio, and the legal use proceed against.
normalIntro.cn: 真实联系：拉丁语 cedere“走”、前缀 pro-“向前”、proceed/precede/succeed 三词，以及法律用法 proceed against。

normal.en: Cedere means 'go' and pro- means 'forward': proceed is to go forward.
normal.cn: cedere 意为“走”，pro- 意为“向前”：proceed 就是向前走。

normal.en: Precede is prae- plus cedere, 'go before'; succeed is sub- plus cedere, 'go next'. The prefix sets the position.
normal.cn: precede 是 prae- 加 cedere，“走在前面”；succeed 是 sub- 加 cedere，“接着走”。前缀定位置。

normal.en: To proceed assumes a pause: something stopped and now resumes. It is motion after a gap.
normal.cn: proceed 假定有停顿：某物停下，现在重启。它是间隙之后的运动。

normal.en: In meetings, proceed is a procedural gate: one item closes, the next opens.
normal.cn: 会议中，proceed 是程序关口：一项关闭，下一项开启。

normal.en: To proceed against someone is to start the legal machinery walking.
normal.cn: proceed against 某人，就是让法律机器开始行走。

abstract.en: Forward is both a direction and a value: progress borrows its authority from the geometry of motion.
abstract.cn: 向前既是方向也是价值：进步从运动的几何学借来权威。

abstract.en: Every procedure is a path made repeatable, so that anyone can walk it without knowing the ground.
abstract.cn: 每一种程序都是被做成可重复的路径，好让任何人都能走而不必认识地形。

abstract.en: Permission to proceed is permission to let time continue; a meeting pauses the world and then releases it.
abstract.cn: 允许 proceed，就是允许时间继续；会议暂停世界，再把它放行。

examples.en: Please proceed with your report.
examples.cn: 请继续你的报告。

examples.en: We proceeded to the next item on the agenda.
examples.cn: 我们进入议程的下一项。

examples.en: The firm proceeded against the contractor for breach of contract.
examples.cn: 公司以违约为由起诉承包商。

dict_mnemonic.text: “扑若细的”——扑过去，像细线一样一路向前 → proceed 前进、继续进行

root: 拉丁语 procedere“向前走”，由 pro-“向前”+ cedere“走”构成；同族有 cede、precede、succeed、exceed。

sensesIntro.en: Nine senses of proceed, all one walk. The walk can resume after a break, advance in space, start a task, follow a procedure, enter the next agenda item, or enter a courtroom.
sensesIntro.cn: proceed 的九个义项，都是同一场行走。这场行走可以在休息后重启、在空间中前进、开始一项任务、遵循程序、进入下一议题，或进入法庭。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: putting one foot in front of the other along a path.
core.cn: 核心意象：沿一条路一步步向前。

branches.en: RESUME: motion restarts after a pause, or an event is allowed to continue.
branches.cn: 重启：停顿后重新运动，或事件被允许继续。

branches.en: ADVANCE: physical forward movement becomes measurable progress.
branches.cn: 推进：物理的向前运动变成可测量的进展。

branches.en: NEXT STEP: the walk becomes a sequence of tasks or agenda items.
branches.cn: 下一步：行走变成任务或议程的序列。

branches.en: PROCEDURE: the path is scripted into repeatable steps.
branches.cn: 程序：路径被写成可重复的步骤。

branches.en: LAW AND SOURCE: proceed against starts legal machinery; the archaic sense comes forth from a source.
branches.cn: 法律与来源：proceed against 启动法律机器；古义指从源头出来。

intro.en: Proceed is a Latin verb. English adds -ing, -ure, and -al, and the root cedere also builds precede, succeed, exceed, and cede.
intro.cn: proceed 是拉丁动词。英语加 -ing、-ure、-al，词根 cedere 还构成 precede、succeed、exceed、cede。

latinIntro.en: Latin procedere 'go forward' sits beside cedere 'go, yield'. The family is directional: prae- gives precede, sub- gives succeed, pro- gives proceed.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 procedere“向前走”旁边是 cedere“走、让”。这个词族是有方向的：prae- 生成 precede，sub- 生成 succeed，pro- 生成 proceed。

items.meaning: an action or piece of business; a legal step
records of a meeting; legal actions
an established way of doing something

latinEntries.meaning: to go forward, advance, come forth

definition_zh: 过程；程序；流程；工序；（法律）程序；（计算机）进程；加工处理
definition_en: a series of actions or changes that leads to a result, or to handle something through such a series
core_image: 一条流水线：原料从一端进入，经过一道道工序，从另一端出来成品
scene: 面包房里，面团要经过发酵、整形、烘烤。Fermenting, shaping and baking take four hours, and that process turns dough into something a shop can sell.
sceneCN: 这里 process 是「流程、工序」（第 1 个义项：为达到结果而进行的一系列动作）；句意：发酵、整形、烘烤要花四小时，这个流程把面团变成店里能卖的成品。图中可辨识物件：面团、发酵箱、整形台、烤炉、出炉的面包；对应第 1 个义项。

pos.zh: 过程；程序；流程；工序；（计算机）进程

senses.title: A series of actions toward a result
senses.definition: a set of actions taken in order to achieve a result
senses.definitionCN: 为达到结果而按序采取的一组动作
senses.example: The hiring process takes three weeks.
senses.exampleCN: 招聘流程需要三周。
senses.why: Latin processus is 'a going forward', from procedere. A process is a path with stages: it treats time as a route to be walked.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语 processus 是“向前推进”，来自 procedere。process 是一条有阶段的路：它把时间当作要走完的路线。

senses.title: A natural series of changes
senses.definition: a course of natural changes that cannot be stopped
senses.definitionCN: 无法阻止的自然变化历程
senses.example: The process of decay begins at once.
senses.exampleCN: 腐烂过程立刻开始。
senses.why: Nature supplies the purest version: growth, erosion, decay. The word describes what happens by itself, without a planner.
senses.whyCN: 自然提供最纯粹的版本：生长、侵蚀、腐烂。这个词描述自行发生、没有规划者的事。

senses.title: A manufacturing procedure
senses.definition: the set of steps by which a product is made
senses.definitionCN: 制造产品所经的一组步骤
senses.example: The new process cuts production time in half.
senses.exampleCN: 新工序把生产时间缩短一半。
senses.why: Industry systematizes the path: each step has an input, an operation, and an output. Process becomes an engineered noun, and process engineering is born.
senses.whyCN: 工业把路径系统化：每一步都有输入、操作与输出。process 成了被工程化的名词，于是有了 process engineering。

senses.title: The legal course of proceedings
senses.definition: the formal steps required by law before a decision is valid
senses.definitionCN: 决定生效前法律要求的正式步骤
senses.example: The court must follow due process.
senses.exampleCN: 法庭必须遵循正当程序。
senses.why: Due process turns the path into a guarantee: the steps are not optional, and skipping one invalidates the result. Procedure and process converge here.
senses.whyCN: 正当程序把路径变成保障：步骤不可省略，跳过一步就使结果无效。procedure 与 process 在此汇合。

senses.title: A running program (computing)
senses.definition: an instance of a program running on a computer
senses.definitionCN: 计算机中正在运行的程序实例
senses.example: The process uses most of the memory.
senses.exampleCN: 这个进程占用了大部分内存。
senses.why: An operating system schedules tasks as a series of steps. Each running instance is a process, a path being walked by the machine.
senses.whyCN: 操作系统把任务安排成一系列步骤。每个运行实例就是一个 process，一条机器正在走的路径。

senses.title: To handle by a procedure
senses.definition: to deal with information or a request according to a set method
senses.definitionCN: 按既定方法处理信息或请求
senses.example: The computer processes thousands of forms a day.
senses.exampleCN: 计算机每天处理数千份表格。
senses.why: The verb turns the noun into action: to put something through the process. What is processed has entered the line and will come out changed.
senses.whyCN: 动词把名词变成动作：把某物送进流程。被 processed 的东西已进入流水线，出来时会变样。

senses.title: To treat food or material
senses.definition: to change a raw material by physical or chemical treatment
senses.definitionCN: 通过物理或化学处理改变原料
senses.example: The factory processes milk into cheese.
senses.exampleCN: 工厂把牛奶加工成奶酪。
senses.why: Food processing is the clearest case: the input is real, the output is real, and the stages are visible. The word carries a neutral tone, though 'processed food' can sound negative.
senses.whyCN: 食品加工是最清楚的例子：输入真实，输出真实，阶段可见。这个词语气中性，尽管 processed food 听起来可能负面。

senses.title: To move in a procession (archaic)
senses.definition: in older usage, to walk in an ordered group
senses.definitionCN: 旧用法：按队列行走
senses.example: The choir processed down the aisle.
senses.exampleCN: 唱诗班列队走过通道。
senses.why: This archaic verb keeps the literal Latin walk. The noun procession is its surviving relative, still used for ceremonial lines of people.
senses.whyCN: 这个古义动词保留拉丁语字面的“走”。名词 procession 是它存活的亲戚，仍指礼仪性的人列。

senses.title: A bony projection (anatomy)
senses.definition: a natural outgrowth or prominence on a bone or organ
senses.definitionCN: 骨或器官上的自然突出部分
senses.example: The mastoid process lies behind the ear.
senses.exampleCN: 乳突位于耳后。
senses.why: Anatomy names protrusions 'processes' because they 'go forward' from the body of the bone. The Latin motion word becomes a shape word.
senses.whyCN: 解剖学把突出部分称作 process，因为它们从骨体“向前伸出”。拉丁运动词变成了形状词。

intro.en: Process began as 'a going forward'. Latin processus comes from procedere, 'to advance', and English first used it for the course of events, then for industrial and legal sequences, and finally for running programs.
intro.cn: process 最初意为“向前推进”。拉丁语 processus 来自 procedere“前进”，英语先用它指事件进程，再指工业与法律序列，最后指运行中的程序。

items.en: First recorded as 'the fact of being carried on; a course of events'.
items.cn: 最早记录为“被推进的事实；事件的进程”。

items.en: From Latin processus 'a going forward, advance, progress', from procedere 'go forward'.
items.cn: 来自拉丁语 processus“前进、推进、进展”，源出 procedere“向前走”。

items.en: procedere = pro- 'forward' + cedere 'go'. The same verb gives proceed and procedure.
items.cn: procedere = pro-“向前”+ cedere“走”。同一动词生成 proceed 与 procedure。

items.en: The modern sense 'a continuous series of actions or changes' becomes established.
items.cn: 现代义“连续的动作或变化序列”确立。

items.en: Industrial use gives process engineering and manufacturing process.
items.cn: 工业用法产生 process engineering 与 manufacturing process。

items.en: Computing adopts the word for a running program, the newest link in the same chain.
items.cn: 计算机在 1960 年代采用这个词指运行程序，是同一链条上最新的一环。

note.en: The first group shares the cedere/procedere root; the second is about nouns that also mean a series of steps.
note.cn: 第一组共享 cedere/procedere 词根，第二组看同样表示“一系列步骤”的名词。

entries.definition: to go forward; the verb behind process.
entries.definitionCN: 向前走；process 背后的动词。

entries.definition: a prescribed set of steps. It stresses the rule, not the evolution.
entries.definitionCN: 规定的步骤。它强调规则，而非演化。

entries.definition: an ordered line of people moving. It keeps the literal walking sense.
entries.definitionCN: 有序行进的人列。它保留字面的行走义。

entries.definition: an official way of doing something. It is a process with authority behind it.
entries.definitionCN: 做某事的官方方式。它是有权威支撑的 process。

entries.definition: a planned way of doing something. It stresses design, not sequence in time.
entries.definitionCN: 有计划的做事方式。它强调设计，而非时间序列。

entries.definition: the way something develops over time. It is broader and less technical than process.
entries.definitionCN: 某物随时间发展的方式。它比 process 更宽、更少技术性。

normalIntro.en: Real links: Latin procedere 'go forward', the proceed/procedure/process family, due process, and the computing sense.
normalIntro.cn: 真实联系：拉丁语 procedere“向前走”、proceed/procedure/process 词族、正当程序，以及计算机义。

normal.en: Processus means 'a going forward'. A process is a path with stages, walked until something comes out.
normal.cn: processus 意为“向前推进”。process 是一条有阶段的路，走到某物出来为止。

normal.en: The verb behind it is proceed: pro- 'forward' plus cedere 'go'. Process is the noun of that walk.
normal.cn: 它背后的动词是 proceed：pro-“向前”加 cedere“走”。process 是那场行走的名词。

normal.en: Procedure is a process with rules attached: the same steps, now mandatory.
normal.cn: procedure 是附上规则的 process：同样的步骤，现在成了必须。

normal.en: Due process means the steps cannot be skipped; skipping one invalidates the result.
normal.cn: 正当程序意味着步骤不可跳过；跳过一步，结果就无效。

normal.en: In computing, a process is a program mid-walk: the machine is following its steps right now.
normal.cn: 计算机中，process 是走到一半的程序：机器正在执行它的步骤。

abstract.en: A process converts time into shape: what was merely passing becomes a route with stages.
abstract.cn: 过程把时间变成形状：原本只是流逝的东西，成了有阶段的路线。

abstract.en: Calling something a process can hide responsibility: nobody did it, it just went through its steps.
abstract.cn: 把某事称作 process 可以隐藏责任：没人做的，它只是走完了步骤。

abstract.en: Nature and factory share the word because both produce an output by ordered change.
abstract.cn: 自然与工厂共享这个词，因为两者都通过有序变化产出结果。

examples.en: Learning a language is a gradual process.
examples.cn: 学语言是一个渐进的过程。

examples.en: The application process is now fully online.
examples.cn: 申请流程现已完全在线。

examples.en: The plant processes raw cocoa into chocolate.
examples.cn: 工厂把生可可加工成巧克力。

dict_mnemonic.text: “扑若塞斯”——扑过去，像塞子一样一环环推进 → process 过程、流程

root: 拉丁语 processus“前进、推进”，源出 procedere“向前走”= pro-“向前”+ cedere“走”；同族有 proceed、procedure、procession。

sensesIntro.en: Nine senses of process, one path in different costumes. The path can be natural (decay), industrial (a production line), legal (due process), digital (a running program), or even anatomical (a bony projection).
sensesIntro.cn: process 的九个义项，是同一条路的不同装扮。这条路可以是自然的（腐烂）、工业的（生产线）、法律的（正当程序）、数字的（运行程序），甚至解剖的（骨突起）。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a route with stages, from input to output.
core.cn: 核心意象：一条有阶段的路，从输入到输出。

branches.en: COURSE: ordered change, whether planned or natural.
branches.cn: 历程：有序变化，无论有计划还是自然发生。

branches.en: MAKING: raw material enters a line and comes out changed.
branches.cn: 制造：原料进入流水线，出来时已变样。

branches.en: LAW: due process makes the steps mandatory and the result valid.
branches.cn: 法律：正当程序使步骤成为必须，使结果有效。

branches.en: COMPUTING: the path becomes a running program, and the verb means to put data through it.
branches.cn: 计算机：路径变成运行中的程序，动词意为让数据走一遍。

branches.en: SHAPE: the archaic walk survives in procession, while anatomy names protrusions 'processes'.
branches.cn: 形状：古义的行走存于 procession，解剖学则把突起称作 process。

intro.en: Process is noun and verb. English adds -ing, -or, and -ed, and the same Latin verb gives proceed, procedure, and procession.
intro.cn: process 既是名词也是动词。英语加 -ing、-or、-ed，同一拉丁动词还生成 proceed、procedure、procession。

latinIntro.en: Latin processus 'advance' comes from procedere 'go forward', built on cedere 'go'. The family is about ordered motion, from law courts to factory floors.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 processus“推进”来自 procedere“向前走”，建立在 cedere“走”上。这个词族关乎有序运动，从法庭到工厂车间。

items.meaning: the act of handling data or material
a device or person that processes
treated by an industrial or chemical process
able to be handled by a procedure
an ordered line of people moving
a prescribed way of doing something

definition_zh: 行列；队伍；游行；（接连而来的）一连串
definition_en: an organized line of people or vehicles moving forward, especially as part of a ceremony or public event
core_image: 一条长队沿道路缓缓前移，最前面的人举着旗，后面的人依次跟上
scene: 婚礼散场后，宾客排成长队跟在花车后面，沿着村道慢慢走向宴席。A long procession followed the bride's car through the lanes.
sceneCN: 这里表示「列队行进的人群」（第 1 个义项：排成行列向前移动的人或车辆）；句意为宾客排成长队跟在婚车后面，穿过乡间小路。

derivatives.zh: 由 procession 加形容词后缀 -al 构成，义为「行列的；游行的」
由 processional 再加 -ly 构成，义为「以列队行进的方式」
由 procession 加 -ary 构成，义为「列队而行的」，常见于描述结队爬行的毛虫

senses.title: An ordered line of people or vehicles moving forward
senses.definition: a group of people or vehicles that move forward one behind another in an ordered line
senses.definitionCN: 一个接一个排成次序、向前移动的一群人或车辆
senses.example: The bridal party formed a procession behind the car.
senses.exampleCN: 迎亲的队伍在车后排成一行。
senses.why: The Latin verb procedere means to go forward, so the noun first names the forward movement itself before it names the line of people doing it.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁动词 procedere 意为「向前走」，所以这个名词先指「向前移动」这件事，再指做这件事的那一列人。

senses.title: A formal parade on a public or religious occasion
senses.definition: a public parade, often with music, flags or religious images, held to mark a festival or ceremony
senses.definitionCN: 常带音乐、旗帜或神像的公开游行，用来纪念节日或仪式
senses.example: The whole town watched the religious procession pass the square.
senses.exampleCN: 全镇的人看着宗教游行经过广场。
senses.why: Such parades already move in an ordered line, so the word could leave its general sense behind and settle on the street-filling ceremony.
senses.whyCN: 这类庆典本来就是排成次序沿街前行，于是词义从泛指的队列收窄为占满街道的仪式性游行。

senses.title: A continuous series of people or things
senses.definition: a series of people or things that come one after another without a break
senses.definitionCN: 一个接一个、中间不断的人或事物
senses.example: The office faced a procession of visitors all morning.
senses.exampleCN: 整个上午办公室面对着一拨又一拨的来访者。
senses.why: A marching line is also a sequence, since each person arrives after the one before, so the picture slides easily into any run of things arriving in turn.
senses.whyCN: 行进队伍本身就是一个序列：后一个人接着前一个人到来，因此这幅画面很自然地滑向「依次到来的一串事物」。

senses.title: The act of moving forward as a group in ritual
senses.definition: the act or ceremony of walking forward together in a set order, especially in church or funeral rites
senses.definitionCN: 按固定次序一起向前行走的动作或仪式，尤见于教堂礼仪与葬礼
senses.example: The choir began its slow procession down the aisle.
senses.exampleCN: 唱诗班开始沿着过道缓缓行进。
senses.why: Here the focus shifts from the line of people to the ritual act itself, which is why the word can name the walking as well as the walkers.
senses.whyCN: 这里重心从「那一列人」转到「行进这个仪式动作」，所以这个词既能指队伍，也能指列队行进的举动。

intro.en: Procession comes from a Latin verb meaning to go forward; the line of people is named after the movement, not the other way round.
intro.cn: procession 来自一个意为「向前走」的拉丁动词；先有「前行」这个动作，才用它来指排成行列的人。

items.en: Cedere meant to go, to withdraw or to yield, and it is the moving element inside many English words.
items.cn: cedere 意为走、退去、让出，是许多英语词里表示「移动」的那个成分。

items.en: The prefix pro- added forward to cedere, giving procedere, to go forward or advance.
items.cn: 前缀 pro- 给 cedere 加上了「向前」，构成 procedere，意为向前走、前进。

items.en: The noun processio named a going forward and later the ordered line of people making that advance.
items.cn: 名词 processio 指「向前行进」，后来也指排成次序完成这次行进的人群。

items.en: Old French kept the word as procession, meaning a ceremonial march, and passed it into English.
items.cn: 古法语沿用 procession 这一形式，指仪式性的行进，并把它传入英语。

items.en: English widened it from religious and funeral lines to any parade, then to any series arriving in turn.
items.cn: 英语把词义从宗教与送葬行列扩展到各种游行，再引申为依次到来的一连串事物。

note.en: The first group gathers words built on the same Latin verb of going; the second gathers words for organised walking and parades.
note.cn: 第一组收同一拉丁「走」动词上的词；第二组收表示有组织地行走与游行的词。

entries.definition: To go on or move forward, especially after a stop.
entries.definitionCN: 继续前行；在停顿之后继续进行。

entries.definition: A series of actions taken to reach a result.
entries.definitionCN: 为达到结果而采取的一系列行动。

entries.definition: An established or official way of doing something.
entries.definitionCN: 既定或正式的做法；程序。

entries.definition: To move back or away from a previous position.
entries.definitionCN: 后退；从原来的位置退去。

entries.definition: A public procession celebrating a special day.
entries.definitionCN: 为庆祝特定日子而举行的公开游行。

entries.definition: An organised walk by a group, often to protest.
entries.definitionCN: 有组织的集体行走，常指抗议游行。

entries.definition: A solemn procession, especially at a funeral.
entries.definitionCN: 庄严肃穆的行列，尤指送葬队伍。

normalIntro.en: The word is built on a Latin verb of going, and everything it means can be traced back to people moving forward in order.
normalIntro.cn: 这个词建立在表示「走」的拉丁动词上，它的各种含义都能回溯到「人们有序地向前移动」。

normal.en: Cedere is the Latin verb to go; pro- pushes it forward, so procedere is simply to go forward.
normal.cn: cedere 是拉丁语「走」的动词，pro- 把它推向前，所以 procedere 就是「向前走」。

normal.en: Procession is the noun of that going forward, which is why it names the movement before it names the crowd.
normal.cn: procession 是「向前走」这个动作的名词形式，所以先指移动，再指做这件事的人群。

normal.en: Funeral and wedding processions use one word because both are ordered lines on the move.
normal.cn: 送葬与婚礼都用同一个词，因为两者都是行进中的有序队列。

normal.en: In procession means arranged in a line, a phrase that still holds the picture of people following one another.
normal.cn: in procession 意为排成队列，这个说法仍保留着人们一个跟着一个的画面。

normal.en: Process and proceed share the root, so all three keep the idea of stepping forward through stages.
normal.cn: process 与 proceed 同根，三者都保留着「一步步向前推进」的意思。

abstract.en: A procession turns separate bodies into one shape, because a line has a direction that no single walker owns.
abstract.cn: 行列把一个个身体合成一个形状，因为一条线的方向不属于任何单独的行进者。

abstract.en: Anything that arrives one after another can be seen as a procession, even when nobody is walking.
abstract.cn: 任何依次到来的东西都能被看成一列队伍，即使没有人在走。

abstract.en: The word suggests that order is visible: you know a procession is there because the line can be seen from far off.
abstract.cn: 这个词暗示秩序是可见的：远远看见那条线，就知道有一列队伍。

examples.en: The funeral procession moved slowly towards the church.
examples.cn: 送葬队伍缓缓向教堂行进。

examples.en: A procession of schoolchildren crossed the bridge in pairs.
examples.cn: 一队小学生两人一排地走过桥。

examples.en: The festival ended with a torchlight procession through the old town.
examples.cn: 节日以穿过老城区的火炬游行结束。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「普若赛神」——一队人吹吹打打抬着神像往前走，像在赛神；记住 procession 是行列、游行队伍。

root: 拉丁语 pro-（向前）+ cedere（走、退让）→ procedere（前进）→ processio（行进、行列），经古法语 procession 进入英语；同族词多与「向前走、依次推进」有关。

sensesIntro.en: The core sense is people moving forward in order; from it come the public parade, the ritual act of walking, and the figurative series that arrives one by one.
sensesIntro.cn: 核心义是人们有次序地向前移动；由此分出公开游行、仪式性的列队行进，以及一个接一个到来的抽象序列。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a long line of people keeping step along a road, flags at the front.
core.cn: 核心意象：一条长队沿道路保持步调前行，旗帜在最前面。

branches.en: a line of marchers keeping step along a road
branches.cn: 行进者沿道路保持步调排成一列

branches.en: a festival parade filling the street with flags
branches.cn: 旗帜填满街道的节日游行

branches.en: cars following one another through the gate
branches.cn: 车辆一辆接一辆驶过大门

branches.en: visitors arriving one after another all day
branches.cn: 访客整天一个接一个地到来

branches.en: a choir walking slowly down the aisle
branches.cn: 唱诗班沿过道缓缓前行

intro.en: The word is held together by a Latin verb of going, its prefix, and two endings that turn the action into a noun and an adjective.
intro.cn: 这个词由表示「走」的拉丁动词、它的前缀，以及两个把动作变成名词和形容词的词尾共同支撑。

latinIntro.en: No reliable Latin cognate is recorded for this word.
latinIntro.cn: 这个词没有可靠的拉丁同族词记录。

items.meaning: a going forward; a line of marchers

items.exampleCN: 行列进行时演奏的音乐

definition_zh: 处理器；中央处理器；对原料、数据或信号进行加工的设备；处理事务的人或机构
definition_en: a device or person that processes something, especially the central unit of a computer that carries out instructions
core_image: 主板中央一块指甲盖大小的芯片，四周的线路像放射状的河道向它汇拢
scene: 笔记本主板中央有一块指甲盖大小的芯片，所有指令都在它这里排队执行。A faster processor cut the export time in half.
sceneCN: 这里指执行指令的中央处理芯片（第 1 个义项：中央处理器）；句意为更快的处理器把导出时间缩短了一半。图中可辨识物件：主板、芯片、散热片、风扇。

pos.zh: 处理器；加工设备；处理者

collocations.zh: 文字处理软件；文字处理机

senses.title: The central unit of a computer
senses.definition: the part of a computer that reads and carries out instructions, often called the central processing unit
senses.definitionCN: 计算机中读取并执行指令的部件，常称中央处理器
senses.example: A faster processor cut the export time in half.
senses.exampleCN: 更快的处理器把导出时间减半。
senses.why: The agent suffix -or names the thing that performs the process, and the chip is the worker inside the machine.
senses.whyCN: 施动后缀 -or 命名执行过程的那个东西，芯片就是机器内部的劳动者。

senses.title: A kitchen machine
senses.definition: an electric machine with blades that chops, slices or mixes food
senses.definitionCN: 带刀片、可切碎、切片或搅拌食物的电动机械
senses.example: She put the nuts in the food processor.
senses.exampleCN: 她把坚果放进了食品加工机。
senses.why: The word left the office for the kitchen because the machine performs the same act on a different material.
senses.whyCN: 这个词从办公室走进厨房，因为机器只是换了一种材料执行同样的动作。

senses.title: A word processor
senses.definition: software, or an older dedicated machine, for writing and editing text
senses.definitionCN: 用于写作与编辑文本的软件或较早的专用机器
senses.example: The old word processor still loads faster than the new suite.
senses.exampleCN: 那台旧文字处理机载入仍比新套件快。
senses.why: Text is the material here, and the machine processes it into a finished page.
senses.whyCN: 这里的材料是文字，机器把它加工成一页成稿。

senses.title: A data processor
senses.definition: a person or system that turns raw data into organised information
senses.definitionCN: 把原始数据变成有条理信息的人或系统
senses.example: The agency acts as a data processor for three hospitals.
senses.exampleCN: 这家机构为三家医院充当数据处理者。
senses.why: In law and business the processor is whoever acts on data supplied by another, so the agent suffix matters.
senses.whyCN: 在法律与商业中，处理者是替他人处理所提供数据的一方，施动后缀在这里很关键。

senses.title: A signal processor
senses.definition: a circuit or program that filters, transforms or analyses electronic signals
senses.definitionCN: 对电子信号进行滤波、变换或分析的电路或程序
senses.example: The hearing aid's signal processor removes the background hum.
senses.exampleCN: 助听器的信号处理器去掉了背景嗡嗡声。
senses.why: Sound and radio are materials too, and the same worker word covers them.
senses.whyCN: 声音与无线电也是材料，同一个「加工者」词同样覆盖它们。

senses.title: A payment processor
senses.definition: a company that moves card and bank payments between buyers, sellers and banks
senses.definitionCN: 在买方、卖方与银行之间传递银行卡与银行支付的机构
senses.example: The payment processor rejected the card before the order was sent.
senses.exampleCN: 支付处理商在订单发出前拒收了这张卡。
senses.why: Money is processed as a stream of authorisations, so the company is named by the act it performs.
senses.whyCN: 钱被当作一连串授权来处理，公司因此以它执行的动作命名。

senses.title: An image processor
senses.definition: a chip or program that turns sensor data into a usable picture
senses.definitionCN: 把传感器数据变成可用图像的芯片或程序
senses.example: The camera's image processor reduces noise in low light.
senses.exampleCN: 相机的图像处理器减少弱光下的噪点。
senses.why: Light becomes numbers, and the processor is the stage where numbers become an image.
senses.whyCN: 光变成数字，处理器是数字变回图像的工位。

senses.title: A machine that treats materials
senses.definition: an industrial device that treats a material by heat, pressure or chemical action
senses.definitionCN: 通过加热、加压或化学作用处理材料的工业设备
senses.example: The plant added a processor for the waste oil.
senses.exampleCN: 工厂增加了一台废油处理设备。
senses.why: This is the factory sense at its plainest: raw material goes in, treated material comes out.
senses.whyCN: 这是最朴素的工厂义：原料进去，处理过的材料出来。

intro.en: Processor is process plus the agent suffix -or. Process comes from Latin processus 'advance, progress', from procedere 'to go forward', built on pro- 'forward' and cedere 'to go'. The computing sense arose in the mid-twentieth century.
intro.cn: processor 是 process 加施动后缀 -or。process 来自拉丁 processus「前进、进展」，上溯 procedere「向前走」，由 pro-「向前」与 cedere「走」构成。计算义在二十世纪中期出现。

items.en: Latin procedere meant to go forward or come forth, built from pro- 'forward' and cedere 'to go, yield'.
items.cn: 拉丁 procedere 指向前走或出来，由 pro-「向前」与 cedere「走、让」构成。

items.en: Processus named an advance, a course or a progression, and English process kept both the forward movement and the set of steps.
items.cn: processus 指前进、进程或推移，英语 process 既保留向前运动，也保留一套步骤。

items.en: The Latin-derived suffix -or names the doer of an action, so a processor is the thing or person that carries the process out.
items.cn: 源自拉丁语的施动后缀 -or 命名动作的执行者，因此处理器就是执行该过程的东西或人。

items.en: From the 1950s the central unit that fetched and executed instructions was called a processor, later the central processing unit.
items.cn: 二十世纪五十年代起，取指令并执行指令的中央单元被称为处理器，后来称中央处理器。

items.en: Food processors and word processors took the same name in the twentieth century because each machine performs a process on a material.
items.cn: 食品加工机与文字处理机在二十世纪用了同一个名字，因为每台机器都在对某种材料执行加工。

items.en: Payment processors and data processors extend the word to organisations that carry out a defined procedure for others.
items.cn: 支付处理商与数据处理者把这个词扩展到替他人执行既定流程的机构。

note.en: The first group looks or sounds like processor; the second group names neighbouring ideas in the same field.
note.cn: 第一组在形音上与「processor」相近；第二组是同一领域里意思相邻的其他说法。

entries.definition: The noun and verb behind the agent; it names the course of steps rather than the doer.
entries.definitionCN: 施动者背后的名词与动词，指步骤过程而非执行者。

entries.definition: The activity itself, formed with -ing rather than the agent suffix.
entries.definitionCN: 这项活动本身，用 -ing 而非施动后缀构成。

entries.definition: The participle describing material that has been through the process.
entries.definitionCN: 描述已经过加工的材料的分词。

entries.definition: A line of people moving forward, from the same Latin verb but not the same sense.
entries.definitionCN: 向前行进的人群，同出那个拉丁动词，但意思不同。

entries.definition: A person who came before another in an office; the ending looks similar but the base differs.
entries.definitionCN: 职位上前任的人；词尾相似，词基不同。

entries.definition: The full name of the main chip, of which processor is the short form.
entries.definitionCN: 主芯片的全称，处理器是其简称。

entries.definition: A device that directs a process rather than carrying out the arithmetic itself.
entries.definitionCN: 指挥过程而非亲自执行运算的装置。

entries.definition: A person or routine that deals with something, often more general than processor.
entries.definitionCN: 处理某事的人或例程，通常比处理器更泛。

entries.definition: Any device that performs work, the broadest word in this field.
entries.definitionCN: 执行工作的任何装置，是这一领域最宽泛的词。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations use the real Latin forward verb, the real agent suffix and real product phrases.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想使用真实的拉丁「向前」动词、真实施动后缀与真实产品搭配。

normal.en: Process comes from Latin procedere, to go forward, and -or marks the thing that does it.
normal.cn: process 来自拉丁 procedere「向前走」，-or 标出执行它的东西。

normal.en: The family runs process, processing, processed, processor and multiprocessor.
normal.cn: 同族词有 process、processing、processed、processor 与 multiprocessor。

normal.en: Fixed phrases mark the uses: central processor, word processor, food processor, payment processor.
normal.cn: 固定说法标出用法：中央处理器、文字处理机、食品加工机、支付处理商。

normal.en: The central processing unit is the full name; processor is the short one.
normal.cn: 中央处理器是全称，processor 是简称。

normal.en: A kitchen machine and a chip share the name because both act on a material.
normal.cn: 厨房机器与芯片共用一个名字，因为两者都对某种材料施加动作。

abstract.en: A processor is a worker that never sees the whole task, only the next instruction.
abstract.cn: 处理器是一个从不见全貌、只看见下一条指令的工人。

abstract.en: The chip is small because its work is narrow: fetch, decode, execute, repeat.
abstract.cn: 芯片之所以小，是因为它的活很窄：取指、译码、执行，再来一遍。

abstract.en: Every screen you see has passed through some processor's hands.
abstract.cn: 你看见的每一块屏幕，都经过某个处理器之手。

examples.en: The new processor runs cooler than the one it replaced.
examples.cn: 新处理器比它所替换的那颗运行得更凉。

examples.en: A payment processor sits between the shop and the bank.
examples.cn: 支付处理商坐在商店与银行之间。

examples.en: The food processor saves her an hour of chopping.
examples.cn: 食品加工机替她省下一小时的切菜时间。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「破塞色」——把一堆活硬塞进去、破开来做，就是处理器

root: process 来自拉丁 processus「前进」，上溯 procedere「向前走」（pro- 向前 + cedere 走）；加施动后缀 -or 构成 processor。计算义二十世纪中期出现，与 processing 同根。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses follow one worker: the central chip, a kitchen blade, a text tool, a data handler, a signal circuit, a payment firm, an image engine, and an industrial treater.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项跟着同一个执行者：中央芯片、厨房刀片、文字工具、数据经手方、信号电路、支付公司、图像引擎，以及工业处理设备。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a fingernail-sized chip at the centre of a board, lines converging on it like rivers.
core.cn: 核心意象：主板中央一块指甲盖大小的芯片，线路像河道一样向它汇拢。

branches.en: THE DOER OF THE STEPS: a chip, a text tool and a data handler all carry out a defined procedure.
branches.cn: 步骤的执行者：芯片、文字工具与数据经手方都在执行既定流程。

branches.en: THE MATERIAL WORKERS: food and light are both put through a machine that turns them into something usable.
branches.cn: 材料加工者：食物与光都被送进机器，变成可用的东西。

branches.en: THE SIGNAL WORKER: a circuit filters a stream that is neither food nor text.
branches.cn: 信号加工者：电路过滤一股既非食物也非文字的流。

branches.en: THE MONEY WORKER: authorisations are passed from buyer to seller to bank.
branches.cn: 金钱加工者：授权从买方传到卖方再到银行。

branches.en: THE INDUSTRIAL WORKER: waste oil goes in, treated material comes out.
branches.cn: 工业加工者：废油进去，处理过的材料出来。

intro.en: Processor is process plus the Latin agent suffix -or, with process from procedere.
intro.cn: processor 是 process 加拉丁施动后缀 -or，process 来自 procedere。

latinIntro.en: Latin procedere gives processus and English process; the Latin agent suffix -or gives processor, the doer of the process.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁 procedere 衍生 processus 与英语 process；拉丁施动后缀 -or 构成 processor，即过程的执行者。

items.meaning: a course of steps; to treat
items.example: English kept both movement and procedure.
items.exampleCN: 英语保留运动与程序两面。

items.meaning: the carrying out of a process

items.exampleCN: 它构成 processor 与 actor 等词。
前缀增加执行者的数量。

definition_zh: 采购；（机构）取得货物与服务的过程；获得
definition_en: the process by which an organization obtains goods and services, or the act of obtaining something
core_image: 一张需求单从部门递出，经过比价与签约，最后变成仓库门口的一批货
scene: 需求单在几个部门之间传了一轮，几份报价摊在桌上，最后一份合同签下，货物才被允许进门。Public procurement must follow open tendering rules.
sceneCN: 需求、比价、签约三道手续走完，货物才被允许进门；句中的 procurement 指「机构取得货物与服务的整个采购过程」（第 1 个义项：从提出需求到签订合同、完成交付的流程）。图中可辨识物件：需求单、报价单、合同、仓库门。

senses.title: An organization's buying process
senses.titleCN: 机构取得货物与服务的采购流程
senses.definition: the whole process by which an organization obtains the goods and services it needs
senses.definitionCN: 机构为取得所需货物与服务而走的整个流程
senses.example: Public procurement must follow open tendering rules.
senses.exampleCN: 政府采购必须遵守公开招标规则。
senses.why: the word began as a term for managing affairs on someone's behalf, and buying is the part of that care that leaves a paper trail.
senses.whyCN: 这个词原指替他人料理事务，而采购正是这种照料中会留下纸面痕迹的那一部分。

senses.title: The purchasing department
senses.definition: the department or team responsible for buying on behalf of the organization
senses.definitionCN: 代表机构负责采购的部门或团队
senses.example: Procurement blocked the order until three quotes arrived.
senses.exampleCN: 采购部门压住订单，直到收到三份报价。
senses.why: the process gave its name to the unit that runs it, a common shift in institutional language.
senses.whyCN: 流程把名字给了执行它的单位，这是机构用语中常见的转称。

senses.title: Government buying
senses.titleCN: 以公共资金进行的政府采购
senses.definition: the purchase of goods and works by public bodies with public money
senses.definitionCN: 公共机构用公共资金购买货物与工程
senses.example: Government procurement is opened to foreign bidders.
senses.exampleCN: 政府采购向外国投标者开放。
senses.why: public money requires rules of fairness, so the general word is paired with the word for the state.
senses.whyCN: 公共资金要求公平规则，因此一般词前面加上了指国家的词。

senses.title: Military supply acquisition
senses.titleCN: 军需物资与装备的采购
senses.definition: the obtaining of weapons, supplies and services for armed forces
senses.definitionCN: 为武装部队取得武器、物资与服务
senses.example: Defence procurement ran years behind the schedule.
senses.exampleCN: 国防采购比计划晚了数年。
senses.why: armed forces buy in secret and at scale, so their buying developed its own vocabulary around the same word.
senses.whyCN: 军队的秘密大批采购使同一词在其内部发展出专门说法。

senses.title: Buying through digital systems
senses.titleCN: 通过电子系统完成的采购
senses.definition: the use of online platforms and systems to buy goods and services
senses.definitionCN: 利用网络平台与系统购买货物与服务
senses.example: E-procurement cut the order cycle from weeks to days.
senses.exampleCN: 电子采购把订单周期从数周缩短到数日。
senses.why: the channel changed, not the act, so a short prefix marks the electronic form.
senses.whyCN: 变的是渠道而不是行为，因此只用一个短前缀标出电子形式。

senses.title: Buying with environmental criteria
senses.titleCN: 把环境标准纳入评审的绿色采购
senses.definition: buying that includes environmental and social conditions in its award criteria
senses.definitionCN: 在评标标准中纳入环境与社会条件的采购
senses.example: Green procurement favoured recycled paper and low-emission vans.
senses.exampleCN: 绿色采购偏向再生纸与低排放货车。
senses.why: when price is no longer the only measure, an adjective is added to the same process.
senses.whyCN: 当价格不再是唯一尺度时，只需在同一流程前加一个形容词。

senses.title: Obtaining something in general
senses.titleCN: 正式用语中一般的「取得、获得」
senses.definition: the obtaining of something abstract, such as funds or evidence
senses.definitionCN: 取得某种抽象之物，如资金或证据
senses.example: The procurement of funds delayed the whole project.
senses.exampleCN: 资金迟迟未能取得，拖住了整个项目。
senses.why: the older and wider sense survives in formal prose, where what is obtained need not be goods.
senses.whyCN: 较旧而较宽的含义留在正式文体中，被取得的东西不一定是货物。

senses.title: Buying as a strategic choice
senses.titleCN: 作为战略决策的采购（自制或外购）
senses.definition: the strategic decision about what to make in house and what to buy outside
senses.definitionCN: 决定什么自己做、什么向外部购买的策略选择
senses.example: Procurement now sits at the table when products are designed.
senses.exampleCN: 如今产品设计时，采购部门也坐在桌边。
senses.why: once buying is planned rather than clerical, it becomes a lever on cost, risk and design.
senses.whyCN: 当采购从文书工作变成事先规划，它就成了影响成本、风险与设计的杠杆。

intro.en: Procurement comes through Old French from Latin procurare 'to take care of, attend to', built on pro- 'for' and curare 'to care for'. Dates are approximate.
intro.cn: procurement 经古法语来自拉丁语 procurare「照料、料理」，由表示「为了、代表」的前缀与 curare「关心、照料」构成。年代均为约数。

items.en: Cura meant 'care, concern, careful attention', and it also lies behind cure, accurate and curious.
items.cn: cura 意为「关心、忧虑、仔细留意」，它也是「治愈」「准确的」「好奇的」等词的根源。

items.en: Curare 'to care for, look after, attend to' is the verb formed from cura.
items.cn: curare「照料、看护、料理」是由 cura 构成的动词。

items.en: Pro- 'for, on behalf of' plus curare gave procurare 'to take care of something for someone, to manage'.
items.cn: 表示「为了、代表」的前缀加 curare 构成 procurare「替某人料理某事、管理」。

items.en: Old French procurer meant 'to manage, take care of, obtain', and English borrowed it in the fourteenth century.
items.cn: 古法语 procurer 意为「管理、照料、取得」，英语在十四世纪借入。

items.en: The noun first meant management or the care of affairs, and only later narrowed to the obtaining of supplies.
items.cn: 这个名词最初指管理或料理事务，后来才收窄为取得物资。

items.en: In the twentieth century the word settled on formal institutional buying, with tenders, contracts and audit trails.
items.cn: 到二十世纪，这个词固定指机构的正式采购，伴随招标、合同与审计记录。

note.en: Group one holds words from the same 'care' root whose meanings have diverged; group two holds words for buying.
note.cn: 第一组同出「关心、照料」这一词根，意义已各自分化；第二组是表示购买的词。

entries.definition: To obtain something, often with effort; the noun names the organized process that does it.
entries.definitionCN: 取得某物，常需费一番功夫；名词指把这件事组织起来的流程。

entries.definition: An official who acts on another's behalf, from the same root; it kept the old sense of managing for someone.
entries.definitionCN: 代表他人行事的官员，同出该词根；保留了「替人管理」的旧义。

entries.definition: Built from the prefix for 'to' plus the care verb: something done carefully, hence exact.
entries.definitionCN: 由表示「朝向」的前缀加「照料」动词构成：仔细做成，因此精确。

entries.definition: From the same care noun: originally 'careful, attentive', later 'eager to know'.
entries.definitionCN: 同出该「关心」名词：原为「仔细、留意」，后转指「想知道」。

entries.definition: The routine buying of goods; procurement adds planning, competition and formal rules.
entries.definitionCN: 日常的货物购买；procurement 另有规划、竞争与正式规则之意。

entries.definition: The obtaining of something, often an asset or a company; it says nothing about tendering.
entries.definitionCN: 取得某物，常指资产或公司；并不涉及招标程序。

entries.definition: The search for and selection of suppliers, the front half of procurement.
entries.definitionCN: 寻找并挑选供应商，是采购流程的前半段。

entries.definition: The providing of goods to those who need them, seen from the giving side rather than the buying side.
entries.definitionCN: 向需要者提供货物，站在给予方而非购买方来看。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations use the real 'care' root, the real institutional phrases and the real family.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想使用真实的「照料」词根、真实的机构搭配与真实词族。

normal.en: The root means 'care': procurement is buying done with care and on paper.
normal.cn: 词根意为「照料」：采购就是带着小心、留下纸面记录的购买。

normal.en: The family runs procure, procurable, procurer and procuration.
normal.cn: 同族词包括采购、可取得的、取得者与代理办理。

normal.en: Fixed phrases mark it: public procurement, procurement process, procurement officer.
normal.cn: 固定搭配标出这个词：政府采购、采购流程、采购主管。

normal.en: The same care root gives accurate and curious, both once meaning careful.
normal.cn: 同一「照料」词根还给出「准确的」与「好奇的」，两者都曾表示「仔细」。

normal.en: Procurement begins with a need and ends with a signed contract.
normal.cn: 采购从一项需求开始，到一份签好的合同结束。

abstract.en: Picture a request form travelling through three desks before it becomes a crate.
abstract.cn: 想象一张需求单走过三张办公桌，最后变成一只货箱。

abstract.en: Picture a scale that weighs not goods but promises.
abstract.cn: 想象一杆秤，称的不是货物，而是承诺。

abstract.en: Picture a gardener who plans what to bring in before winter.
abstract.cn: 想象一位园丁，在入冬前就盘算好要备进什么。

examples.en: Procurement rules require at least three competing bids.
examples.cn: 采购规则要求至少三家竞标报价。

examples.en: The hospital's procurement of masks began before the outbreak.
examples.cn: 这家医院在疫情暴发前就已采购口罩。

examples.en: She moved from procurement into supply-chain planning.
examples.cn: 她从采购转到供应链规划。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「pro（为了）+ cure（关心）+ ment」——为机构所需之事操心办理 → 采购

root: 古法语 procurement 来自拉丁语 procurare（照料、料理、管理）＝pro-（为了、代表）＋curare（关心、照料），词根 cura 意为「关心」。原义为管理事务，后收窄为采购。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses start from caring for an institution's affairs and narrow into the paper process of buying, which then spreads to government, defence, digital systems and strategy.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项从「替机构料理事务」出发，收窄为有纸面流程的购买，再扩展到政府、国防、数字系统与战略。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a request form that becomes a signed contract and then a crate at the door.
core.cn: 核心意象：一张需求单变成一份签好的合同，再变成门口的一只货箱。

branches.en: THE PROCESS AND ITS OFFICE: a way of caring for needs hardens into a department.
branches.cn: 流程与其部门：照料需求的方式固定为一个部门。

branches.en: PUBLIC AND ARMED BUYING: public money and secrecy each add their own rules.
branches.cn: 公共与军事购买：公共资金与保密各自添上一套规则。

branches.en: NEW CRITERIA: a digital channel and environmental scoring change how the same act is done.
branches.cn: 新标准：数字渠道与环境评分改变的是同一行为的做法。

branches.en: WIDER OBTAINING: the old sense survives where what is obtained is funds or evidence.
branches.cn: 更宽的取得：旧义留在取得资金或证据的场合。

branches.en: AT THE DESIGN TABLE: buying becomes a decision about what not to make.
branches.cn: 坐上设计桌：采购成了决定「不做什么」的决策。

intro.en: The word is a Latin prefix, a Latin noun of care and its verb, plus a French noun ending.
intro.cn: 这个词由一个拉丁前缀、一个表「关心」的拉丁名词及其动词，再加一个法语名词词尾构成。

latinIntro.en: Latin cura gives cure, accurate and curious as well as procure and procurement.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 cura 除构成「采购」一族外，还给出「治愈」「准确的」「好奇的」等词。

items.example: The prefix says the care is exercised for someone else.
items.exampleCN: 这个前缀说明照料是替别人做的。

items.example: The noun names the attention being given.
items.exampleCN: 这个名词指所付出的留意。

items.structure: curare, curavi, curatum (Latin verb, first conjugation)
items.example: The verb turns care into an activity.
items.exampleCN: 这个动词把「关心」变成行动。

items.example: Procurare is the source of the English family.
items.exampleCN: 这个词是英语这一词族的来源。

items.example: They procured the parts within a week.
items.exampleCN: 他们一周内就取得了零件。

items.example: Procurement takes months for large works.
items.exampleCN: 大型工程的采购要花几个月。

items.example: The rare alloy was no longer procurable.
items.exampleCN: 那种稀有合金已无法采购到。

items.example: The procurer dealt with every supplier.
items.exampleCN: 采购者与每一家供应商打交道。

items.example: The count was accurate to the last crate.

definition_zh: 生产；制造；产生；出示；排演；农产品
definition_en: to make, grow or bring something into existence; as a noun, farm products
core_image: 果园枝头的果子被摘进篮子，篮子上贴着产地标签
scene: 农户把今年收的果子装筐，运到镇上的集市。The farm produces enough apples to fill a stall at the town market.
sceneCN: 农户把今年收的果子装筐运到镇上集市；句中的 produces 指「种出、出产某物」（第 2 个义项：以种植或养殖方式产出）。图中可辨识物件：果园、果筐、集市摊位、产地标签；对应第 1 个义项。

pos.zh: 生产；制造；产生；出示；排演
农产品（重音移到第一音节）

senses.title: Make or manufacture
senses.definition: to make something, especially in a factory or by a process
senses.definitionCN: 造出某物，尤指在工厂或经某一过程
senses.example: The plant produces parts for wind turbines.
senses.exampleCN: 这家工厂生产风力涡轮机的零件。
senses.why: The Latin verb means to lead forward, so making is bringing material forward into a finished thing.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁动词意为「向前引出」，因此制造就是把材料引成成品。

senses.title: Grow or yield from land
senses.definition: to grow crops or raise animals as a result of farming
senses.definitionCN: 通过耕作或养殖产出作物或畜禽
senses.example: The farm produces enough apples to fill a stall at the town market.
senses.exampleCN: 这个农场种的苹果足够装满镇上集市的一个摊位。
senses.why: A field yielding fruit is the same bringing-forth, with land rather than a machine doing the work.
senses.whyCN: 田地结出果实也是同一种「带出」，只是出力的是土地而非机器。

senses.title: Cause an effect
senses.definition: to cause something to happen or to exist
senses.definitionCN: 使某事发生或存在
senses.example: The new policy produced a sharp fall in complaints.
senses.exampleCN: 新政策使投诉量大幅下降。
senses.why: Once anything can be brought forth, the word covers results that are not physical objects.
senses.whyCN: 一旦任何东西都能被「带出」，这个词便涵盖并非实物的结果。

senses.title: Show or bring forward
senses.definition: to present something for inspection, such as a document or a ticket
senses.definitionCN: 把某物拿出来供查验，如文件或票据
senses.example: The witness produced the original receipt.
senses.exampleCN: 证人出示了原始收据。
senses.why: Bringing something before someone is a literal leading forward, which explains the legal use.
senses.whyCN: 把东西带到某人面前，字面上就是「向前引出」，这解释了法律用法。

senses.title: Stage a play or film
senses.definition: to prepare and present a play, film or show for an audience
senses.definitionCN: 筹备并向观众呈现戏剧、电影或节目
senses.example: The company will produce the play in the spring.
senses.exampleCN: 剧团将在春天排演这部戏。
senses.why: A show is brought out before an audience, so the cultural sense keeps the forward direction.
senses.whyCN: 一部戏被带到观众面前，因此文化义保留了「向前」的方向。

senses.title: Generate energy
senses.definition: to generate power, heat or another form of energy
senses.definitionCN: 发出电力、热量或其他形式的能量
senses.example: The dam produces power for three provinces.
senses.exampleCN: 这座大坝为三个省发电。
senses.why: Energy is led out of a source into a usable current, which fits the word's movement image.
senses.whyCN: 能量从源头被引出成可用的电流，正合这个词的「引出」意象。

senses.title: Farm products as a mass noun
senses.titleCN: 作不可数名词指农产品
senses.definition: fresh food grown on farms, sold as a group rather than counted one by one
senses.definitionCN: 农场种出的新鲜食物，作为整体出售而非逐件计数
senses.example: The shop buys its produce from nearby growers.
senses.exampleCN: 这家店从附近农户采购农产品。
senses.why: The verb's result became a collective noun for what the land brings forth.
senses.whyCN: 动词的结果转成了集合名词，指土地带出的东西。

senses.title: The fresh-food section of a shop
senses.definition: the fruit and vegetable section of a shop, or its stock
senses.definitionCN: 商店的果蔬区或其存货
senses.example: The produce aisle was restocked before opening.
senses.exampleCN: 开门前生鲜区补好了货。
senses.why: Retail narrows the collective noun to one department, the place where farm goods are sold.
senses.whyCN: 零售把集合名词收窄为一个部门，即卖农产品的地方。

intro.en: Produce comes from Latin producere 'to lead forward, bring out', through French. The noun for farm goods is a later English development of the same word.
intro.cn: produce 经法语来自拉丁 producere「向前引出、带出」；指农产品的名词义是同一词在英语中的后起发展。

items.en: Ducere meant 'to lead, draw'. It gives duct, conduct, reduce and educate.
items.cn: ducere 意为「引导、拉」，衍生 duct、conduct、reduce 与 educate。

items.en: Pro- 'forward' plus ducere produced producere, 'to lead forward, bring out, bring forth'.
items.cn: pro-「向前」加 ducere 构成 producere，意为「向前引出、带出」。

items.en: Old French produire carried the verb into English in the fifteenth century.
items.cn: 古法语 produire 在十五世纪把这个动词带入英语。

items.en: By the sixteenth century produce could mean bring forward a document as well as bring goods into being.
items.cn: 到十六世纪，produce 既可指造出货物，也可指出示文件。

items.en: The mass noun for crops and fresh food appeared later, first in English rather than in Latin.
items.cn: 指作物与新鲜食物的不可数名词出现更晚，是英语自身的发展而非拉丁语原有。

items.en: Source uncertain: the first date of the farm noun is not firmly recorded, and the year is approximate.
items.cn: 来源不确定：农产品名词的最早年代没有确切记录，给出的年份只是约数。

note.en: Group one holds same-root words constantly confused with produce; group two holds near verbs for making and yielding.
note.cn: 第一组是同根且常与 produce 混淆的词；第二组是表示制造与产出的近义动词。

entries.definition: The thing made; produce as a verb makes products but never names them.
entries.definitionCN: 造出来的东西；作动词的 produce 制造产品，却不用它来指产品。

entries.definition: The activity or total output; it is what happens while produce is what is done.
entries.definitionCN: 活动或总产出；produce 是动作，production 是过程或总量。

entries.definition: The person or firm that makes; the verb names the act, not the actor.
entries.definitionCN: 制造的人或企业；动词指动作，不指施动者。

entries.definition: Re- 'again' plus produce: to make a copy or to breed; it repeats rather than originates.
entries.definitionCN: re-「再」加 produce：复制或繁殖；是重复而非原创。

entries.definition: The everyday verb for creating something; it is neutral in register where produce is formal.
entries.definitionCN: 创造某物的日常动词；语体中性，而 produce 较正式。

entries.definition: Making goods industrially; it rules out crops and effects, which produce allows.
entries.definitionCN: 工业制造货物；排除作物与结果，而 produce 都允许。

entries.definition: Producing power, data or ideas; it is close in sense three and six but rarer for goods.
entries.definitionCN: 产生电力、数据或想法；接近第 3、6 义，但少用于货物。

entries.definition: To give a crop or a result, often under pressure; it is the farming half of produce.
entries.definitionCN: 出产作物或结果，常含受压之意；是 produce 中务农的一半。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: the lead-forward root, the mass noun and the fixed phrases.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：「向前引出」词根、不可数名词与固定搭配。

normal.en: Pro- 'forward' plus ducere 'lead': to produce is to lead something into being.
normal.cn: pro-「向前」加 ducere「引导」：produce 就是把某物引出来。

normal.en: The family runs produce, product, production, producer, productive and reproduce.
normal.cn: 同族词有 produce、product、production、producer、productive 与 reproduce。

normal.en: Fixed phrases: produce evidence, produce results, farm produce, locally produced.
normal.cn: 固定说法：出示证据、产生结果、农产品、本地生产的。

normal.en: The noun shifts its stress to the first syllable, which is how English marks the change of word class.
normal.cn: 作名词时重音移到第一音节，这是英语标记词性变化的方式。

normal.en: The same root appears in conduct, introduce, reduce and educate.
normal.cn: 同一词根出现在 conduct、introduce、reduce 与 educate 中。

abstract.en: Picture a tree handing fruit into a basket one branch at a time.
abstract.cn: 想象一棵树一根枝一根枝地把果子交进篮子。

abstract.en: Picture a document sliding across a desk to be checked.
abstract.cn: 想象一份文件在桌面上滑过去接受查验。

abstract.en: Picture a switch that turns a river's weight into light in a room.
abstract.cn: 想象一个开关，把河流的重量变进房间的灯光。

examples.en: The region produces more olive oil than it can sell at home.
examples.cn: 该地区生产的橄榄油超过本地能卖出的量。

examples.en: The lawyer asked the company to produce the missing records.
examples.cn: 律师要求公司出示缺失的记录。

examples.en: A single change in the wording produced a very different response.
examples.cn: 措辞上的一处改动引出了很不一样的反应。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「pro（向前）+ duce（引导）」——把东西一路引出来，就是生产与出产

root: 拉丁 producere「向前引出、带出」= pro-（向前）+ ducere「引导」；经古法语 produire 进入英语。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses follow one bringing-forth: manufacturing, farming, causing an effect, showing a document, staging a show, generating power, farm goods as a mass noun and finally the shop's fresh section.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项围绕「带出」这个动作：制造、种出、引起结果、出示文件、排演、发电、作不可数名词指农产品，最后是商店的生鲜区。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a basket of picked fruit carrying a label that says where it grew.
core.cn: 核心意象：一篮摘下的果子，标签上写着它长在哪里。

branches.en: MAKING AND GROWING: a factory line and a field are both ways of leading material into a result.
branches.cn: 制造与种植：工厂流水线与田地，都是把材料引成结果的方式。

branches.en: BROUGHT FORTH: an effect and a document are both brought forward where they can be seen.
branches.cn: 被带出：结果与文件都被带到能被看见的地方。

branches.en: STAGE AND SHOP: a show and a fresh-food aisle are places where produce is presented to the public.
branches.cn: 舞台与店铺：演出与生鲜区，都是把出产呈现给公众的场所。

branches.en: POWER: energy is led out of a source into a current.
branches.cn: 电力：能量从源头被引出成电流。

branches.en: MASS NOUN: what the land brings forth becomes a collective name for food.
branches.cn: 集合名词：土地带出的东西成了食物的统称。

intro.en: Produce is a Latin verb of leading forward, and its prefix and root still build a large English family.
intro.cn: produce 是表示「向前引出」的拉丁动词，其前缀与词根仍构成一大片英语词族。

latinIntro.en: Latin ducere gives conduct, introduce, reduce and educate; pro- adds the forward direction kept in produce.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁 ducere 衍生 conduct、introduce、reduce 与 educate；pro- 增添 produce 保留的向前方向。

items.example: The prefix points the action outward.
items.exampleCN: 这个前缀把动作指向外。

items.example: The product sells in six countries.

definition_zh: 产品；产物；成果；（数学）乘积；（化学）生成物
definition_en: something produced by a process, a reaction, a multiplication or human work
core_image: 流水线尽头，一只刚成型的物件被机械臂放进托盘，旁边堆着已经空了的料箱
scene: 流水线尽头，一只刚成型的物件被机械臂放进托盘，旁边堆着已经空了的料箱。Water is the product of the reaction between hydrogen and oxygen.
sceneCN: 这里 product 指化学反应生成的产物（第 1 个义项：反应结束后新生成的物质）；句意：水是氢与氧反应的生成物。图中可辨识物件：传送带、机械臂、托盘、空料箱；对应第 1 个义项。

pos.zh: 产品；产物；成果；乘积；生成物

forms.label: 形容词（多产的；生产性的）

senses.title: What a chemical reaction makes
senses.titleCN: 化学反应生成的新物质
senses.definition: a substance formed when other substances react
senses.definitionCN: 由其他物质发生反应后生成的新物质
senses.example: Water is the product of the reaction between hydrogen and oxygen.
senses.exampleCN: 水是氢与氧反应的生成物。
senses.why: the word is the past participle of a Latin verb meaning to lead forth, so a product is literally what has been brought out of a process.
senses.whyCN: 这个词是拉丁动词「引出」的过去分词，因此 product 字面就是「被过程带出来的东西」。

senses.title: A thing made for sale
senses.definition: an item manufactured or grown in order to be sold
senses.definitionCN: 为出售而制造或种植的物品
senses.example: The company moved its best product to the front of the catalogue.
senses.exampleCN: 公司把最好的产品移到目录前页。
senses.why: commerce narrowed the general sense of what is brought forth to what is brought forth for a buyer.
senses.whyCN: 商业把「被带出来的东西」这一通义收窄为「为买家带出来的东西」。

senses.title: A result of effort
senses.definition: an outcome of work, thinking or events, often abstract
senses.definitionCN: 工作、思考或事件带来的结果，常为抽象之物
senses.example: The report was the product of three years of fieldwork.
senses.exampleCN: 这份报告是三年野外工作的成果。
senses.why: if a process brings something out, anything brought out counts, including knowledge and institutions.
senses.whyCN: 只要过程能带出东西，被带出的一切都算，包括知识与制度。

senses.title: The result of multiplication
senses.definition: the number obtained by multiplying two or more numbers
senses.definitionCN: 两个或多个数相乘所得的数
senses.example: The product of six and seven is forty-two.
senses.exampleCN: 六与七的乘积是四十二。
senses.why: mathematics borrowed the same participle: multiplication brings forth a number from two others.
senses.whyCN: 数学借用了同一个分词：乘法从两个数里带出一个数。

senses.title: A child of its time or place
senses.definition: a person or thing shaped entirely by a particular background
senses.definitionCN: 完全由某一背景塑造的人或事物
senses.example: He was a product of the same crowded schools he later criticized.
senses.exampleCN: 他正是他后来批评的那种拥挤学校的产物。
senses.why: the metaphor says that circumstances manufacture people in the way a factory manufactures goods.
senses.whyCN: 这个比喻说环境造人，正如工厂造货。

senses.title: Farm output
senses.definition: crops or other goods grown from the land, often in the plural
senses.definitionCN: 地里种出的作物等物产，常用复数
senses.example: The market sells local products from the surrounding farms.
senses.exampleCN: 这个市场出售周边农场的本地农产品。
senses.why: farming speaks of its output as produce, and the plural products marks things grown rather than made.
senses.whyCN: 农业把自己的产出说成 produce，复数 products 标记的是种出来的东西，而非造出来的。

senses.title: A work of media or art
senses.titleCN: 媒体或艺术作品的产物
senses.definition: a film, recording or other creative work considered as an item made by a studio
senses.definitionCN: 被视为由制片机构制作的电影、录音等创作成品
senses.example: The studio treats every film as a product with a release date.
senses.exampleCN: 制片方把每部电影都当作有发行日期的产品。
senses.why: the entertainment industry uses the commercial sense of the word, so a film becomes a product beside toys and tickets.
senses.whyCN: 娱乐业使用这个词的商业义，于是电影与玩具、门票并列成为产品。

senses.title: One item in a brand range
senses.titleCN: 品牌系列中的单个品项
senses.definition: a single item within a company's range, tracked separately in sales and marketing
senses.definitionCN: 公司系列中的单个品项，在销售与营销中单独核算
senses.example: Each product in the range has its own price and its own page.
senses.exampleCN: 系列中的每个产品都有自己的价格与页面。
senses.why: marketing splits a range into countable units, and the word becomes the unit of accounting rather than the whole output.
senses.whyCN: 营销把一个系列拆成可数的单位，这个词于是成为核算单位，而不是全部产出。

intro.en: Product comes from Latin productum, the neuter past participle of producere, to lead forth, built on pro-, forward, and ducere, to lead. It entered English in the sixteenth century. Dates are approximate.
intro.cn: product 出自拉丁语 productum，即 producere「引出」的中性过去分词；该动词由 pro-「向前」与 ducere「引导」构成。它在 16 世纪进入英语。年代均为约数。

items.en: Ducere meant to lead, draw or guide; its past participle ductum supplied a long series of English words. The deeper Indo-European root is a reconstruction.
items.cn: ducere 意为「引导、拉、带领」，其过去分词 ductum 提供了一长串英语词。更早的印欧词根属于重构。

items.en: Pro-, forward, plus ducere produced producere, to lead forth, bring out, extend, which is the source of produce, product and production.
items.cn: pro-「向前」加 ducere 构成 producere「引出、带出、延长」，是 produce、product 与 production 的来源。

items.en: The neuter participle productum came to be used as a noun for something brought out or brought forth, the direct model of the English word.
items.cn: 中性分词 productum 被当作名词使用，指被带出、被产生的东西，是英语词的直接样板。

items.en: Product entered English in the sixteenth century, first as a general word for a result and also as the mathematical term for the result of multiplication.
items.cn: product 于 16 世纪进入英语，最初泛指结果，同时也是表示乘法结果的数学术语。

items.en: From the nineteenth century the commercial sense of a manufactured item for sale became dominant, and the plural products spread into farming and marketing.
items.cn: 从 19 世纪起，指供出售的制成品这一商业义占据主导，复数形式 products 又扩散到农业与营销。

items.en: First date uncertain: the century of entry is well attested, but the earliest citation of the commercial sense is not settled, so the date given for that sense is approximate.
items.cn: 首见年代不确定：进入英语的世纪有可靠记载，但商业义的最早书证尚无定论，因此为该义给出的年代只是约数。

note.en: The first group shares the produce stem; the second group names other results and other stages of making something.
note.cn: 第一组共享 produce 词干；第二组是其他表示结果或制作阶段的词。

entries.definition: The verb meaning to bring forth; its noun form, pronounced differently, means fresh farm goods as a mass.
entries.definitionCN: 意为「产生、生产」的动词；其名词形式读音不同，指作为整体的新鲜农产品。

entries.definition: The activity or amount of making things; a product is the thing, production is the making of it.
entries.definitionCN: 指制作活动或产量；product 是物，production 是制作这件事。

entries.definition: Something made incidentally while the main product is being made; it is not the intended output.
entries.definitionCN: 在制造主要产品时顺带产生的东西，不是有意要的产出。

entries.definition: The person or firm that makes the product; the -er ending marks the maker rather than the made.
entries.definitionCN: 制作产品的人或公司；词尾 -er 标记制作者，而不是被制作之物。

entries.definition: The general word for what follows from something; it does not imply that the thing was made or sold.
entries.definitionCN: 泛指由某事带来的结果；不含「被制造或被出售」的意思。

entries.definition: What a system turns out, often measured as a rate or total; it stresses quantity more than the item itself.
entries.definitionCN: 系统产出的东西，常以速率或总量计量；强调数量多过单件物品。

entries.definition: The amount obtained from a process, especially a reaction or a field; chemistry counts yield, not products alone.
entries.definitionCN: 从过程得到的量，尤指反应或田地；化学算的是收率，而不只是产物本身。

entries.definition: Movable items for sale, always plural; it is a commercial collective, while product can name one item.
entries.definitionCN: 可供出售的动产，总用复数；它是商业集合名词，而 product 可以指单件。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: the real Latin verb, the real word family and real commercial phrases.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：真实的拉丁动词、真实的同族词与真实的商业说法。

normal.en: Pro- forward plus ducere to lead: to lead something out of a process.
normal.cn: pro-「向前」加 ducere「引导」：把某物从过程中引出来。

normal.en: The family runs produce, product, production, productive, productivity and producer.
normal.cn: 同族词有 produce、product、production、productive、productivity 与 producer。

normal.en: Fixed phrases mark the commercial sense: product line, product launch, final product.
normal.cn: 固定搭配标出商业义：产品线、产品发布、成品。

normal.en: The same word serves the reaction and the multiplication, which is why chemistry and arithmetic share it.
normal.cn: 同一个词既服务反应也服务乘法，所以化学与算术共用它。

normal.en: Product and by-product differ by one prefix: the second is what came out although nobody planned it.
normal.cn: product 与 by-product 只差一个前缀：后者是没人计划却照样出来的东西。

abstract.en: Picture a conveyor belt that ends exactly where the empty crates begin.
abstract.cn: 想象一条传送带的终点，正好是空料箱开始的地方。

abstract.en: Picture a child who repeats the habits of a school he later argues against.
abstract.cn: 想象一个孩子，重复着他后来反对的那所学校的习惯。

abstract.en: Picture two numbers meeting and leaving one number behind.
abstract.cn: 想象两个数相遇，留下一个数。

examples.en: The reaction produces a gas as its main product.
examples.cn: 这个反应的主要产物是一种气体。

examples.en: A product that nobody can repair will not keep its buyers.
examples.cn: 无人能修的产品留不住买家。

examples.en: The product of the two lengths gives the area of the rectangle.
examples.cn: 两条边的乘积给出矩形的面积。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「pro（向前）+ duct（引导）」——把东西往前带出来的结果 → 产品、产物

root: 拉丁 ducere「引导」→ pro- 加 ducere 成 producere「引出」→ 过去分词 productum → 英语 product「被带出的东西」；16 世纪进入英语，商业义确切首见年代无定论。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses follow one act: something is led out of a process. The act then serves a reaction, a factory, a piece of work, a multiplication, a whole era, a farm, a studio and finally one shelf item.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项沿同一个动作展开：某物被从过程中引出来。这个动作随后服务于反应、工厂、一项工作、一次乘法、一个时代、一片农田、一家制片机构，最后是货架上的一个单品。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: the end of a conveyor belt where a finished object drops into a tray beside empty crates.
core.cn: 核心意象：传送带的尽头，一件成品落进托盘，旁边是空了的料箱。

branches.en: THE REACTION OUTPUT: a new substance appears where two others met.
branches.cn: 反应产出：两种物质相遇之处出现一种新物质。
